Appropriately assesses patients of varying diagnoses and disorders requiring Physical Therapy according to established guidelines. Age range treated includes neonatal, pediatric, adolescent, adult, and geriatric. Staff will be assigned only age ranges for which they meet education, experience, and training.
Patients 0-21 years old with CCS coverage are to be treated by CCS paneled therapists or under the oversight of a CCS paneled therapist.
Establishes functional goals in collaboration with the interdisciplinary team based on the patient's rehabilitation potential.

Develops, implements & modifies treatment plan in collaboration with interdisciplinary team to achieve goals. Utilizes evidence-based practice as available. Incorporates patient/family/Care Partner needs, interests/ goals in the development and execution of treatment plan.

Provides patient/family/Care Partner/caregiver education, initiating as soon as feasible after admission. Works to ensure transfer of knowledge using a variety of techniques (i.e., teach-back, demonstration, video, written handouts).
Establishes and follows patient precautions. Observes patient's responses to treatment and reports unusual occurrences. Follows handoff guidelines.
